title: 第一卷 第2章 强强大排档！
slug: 重生1989我一赌鬼带全家顿顿吃肉
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

小龙虾开始真正火爆全国，并成为一种全国性的“夜宵顶流”现象，主要还是在2015年前后。

在80年代末，人们甚至嫌弃小龙虾。

一来是因为小龙虾壳厚肉少，泥腥味重；二来则是和小龙虾的生活习性有关。

小龙虾对生存环境并不挑剔，农田、藕塘甚至是臭水沟中，都有它们的身影，给人的第一印象，就是极其不卫生。

加之繁殖迅速，容易泛滥成灾，导致粮食和藕大量减产，让很多农民深恶痛绝。

但身为穿越者的王建军却深知，小龙虾可是好东西，二三十年后，不仅火爆全国，更是被制作成无数种顶级美食，让人垂涎欲滴。

“王强，那些小龙虾你不准备拿来做菜？”

王建军突然开口问了一句。

“建军哥，你在开什么玩笑呢。这些小龙虾别说人吃，就连狗都嫌弃，渔民不要了丢弃在我这，我准备拿回去捣碎了喂鸡鸭。”

王强被问得丈二和尚摸不着头脑。

“暴殄天物！简直暴殄天物！”

王建军忍不住发出感慨。

不给王强说话的机会，王建军继续说道：“王强，你的大排档生意不好，是因为没有属于自己的特色菜。今天，我来教你制作一道顶级美食，保证你的大排档生意火到爆炸！”

“建军哥，你在说什么呢？”

王强彻底被王建军给弄懵了。

“少废话，没钱还我，就听我的。先把那筐小龙虾给拿过来，个大的用刷子仔细洗刷干净，个小的给我剥成虾球。”

王建军几乎是下令道。

“呃……好的。”

毕竟欠人家钱，王强除了听从安排，还能说什么。反正他的大排档也没什么生意，闲着也是闲着，他倒要看看，王建军究竟在搞什么名堂。

很快，在两人的通力合作下，一大筐小龙虾被洗刷干净，并换上了清水。

王建军根据后世的记忆，大虾准备拿来做油焖大虾，小的剥壳后做成油炸虾球。

吩咐王强准备好葱姜蒜后，他先把虾球肉腌制一下，然后下锅爆炒。

王强在一旁看着，满腹疑惑：狗都嫌弃的东西，做出来的食物真的能好吃？光是那股泥腥味，就让人作呕啊！

王建军没管王强，只管忙活。

“料酒！”

爆炒完毕，最后一步，洒上料酒。

王强闻言，忙不迭递上料酒。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Crayfish became really popular across the country and became a national "top late night snack" phenomenon, mainly around 2015.

In the late 1980s, people even disliked crayfish.

Firstly, it is because the crayfish has a thick shell, less meat and a strong muddy smell; secondly, it is related to the living habits of the crayfish.

Crayfish are not picky about their living environment. They can be found in farmland, lotus ponds and even smelly ditches. The first impression given is that they are extremely unhygienic.

In addition, it reproduces rapidly and is prone to flooding, resulting in a large reduction in grain and lotus root production, which is hated by many farmers.

But as a time traveler, Wang Jianjun knows very well that crayfish is a good thing. Twenty or thirty years later, not only has it become popular across the country, but it has also been made into countless kinds of top-notch delicacies, making people salivate.

"Wang Qiang, aren't you going to use those crayfish for cooking?"

Wang Jianjun suddenly asked.

"Brother Jianjun, are you kidding? Not only do people eat these crayfish, even dogs despise them. The fishermen don't want them anymore and throw them away here. I'm going to take them back and pound them to feed the chickens and ducks."

Wang Qiang was asked such a question that Monk Zhang Er was confused.

"What a waste! What a waste!"

Wang Jianjun couldn't help but sigh.

Without giving Wang Qiang a chance to speak, Wang Jianjun continued: "Wang Qiang, your food stall business is not good because you don't have your own special dishes. Today, I will teach you how to make a top-notch delicacy to ensure that your food stall business will explode!"

"Brother Jianjun, what are you talking about?"

Wang Qiang was completely confused by Wang Jianjun.

"Stop talking nonsense. If you don't have money to pay me back, just listen to me. First, bring over the basket of crayfish. Wash the big ones carefully with a brush, and peel the small ones into shrimp balls for me."

Wang Jianjun almost ordered.

"Uh...ok."

After all, he owed money to others, so what else could Wang Qiang do besides obey the arrangement.Anyway, his food stall didn't have much business, so he was just idle. He wanted to see what Wang Jianjun was up to.

Soon, with the joint efforts of the two, a large basket of crayfish was cleaned and replaced with clean water.

According to the memory of later generations, Wang Jianjun planned to use the prawns to make braised prawns, peel the small ones and make fried shrimp balls.

After telling Wang Qiang to prepare onions, ginger and garlic, he first marinated the shrimp balls and meat, then stir-fried them.

Wang Qiang watched from the side, full of doubts: Can the food made from something even dogs despise really taste delicious?Just the muddy smell makes people sick!

Wang Jianjun ignored Wang Qiang and just kept busy.

"Cooking wine!"

After stir-frying, the last step is to sprinkle cooking wine.

Wang Qiang heard this and hurriedly handed over the cooking wine.
